collision_energy.evidence: Up to 15 of the most abundant isotope patterns with charges 2 to 5 from the survey scan were selected with an isolation window of 0.7 m/z and fragmented by higher-energy collision dissociation with normalized collision energies of 32, whereas the dynamic exclusion was set to 35 s.
